column1: # What the ZAP baseline does with each rule (ADR-0019). Tab separated: id, action, note.
# FAIL turns the job red, WARN reports, IGNORE silences. A rule not listed here is WARN.
# Every IGNORE says why it does not apply. The other columns are read by ZAP as a note only.
# The security headers of docs/09-security-privacy.md, section 5, must stay on the site.
# ZAP has no rule for a missing Referrer-Policy.
